purpose: Materialize topology-isolated local 3-D collision/support geometry at three fixed SDF resolutions and qualify a deterministic junction-local XY/z correction for every sealed C08 route frame before any causal topology replay.

approval.scope: Proposed one-shot C08 geometry/trajectory qualification only; zero LiDAR, M1D/B0 inference, graph, training, C09/C10 or M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: 2026-08-14 user approved design and implementation preparation only; a separate explicit execution approval is required.

raw_sources: three sealed C08 graph.json, splines.json and geometry_parameters.json inputs listed in the frozen-input manifest
three sealed C08 trajectory NPZ inputs listed in the frozen-input manifest
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local read-only research reuse of pinned Cano-derived assets; the native perception OBJ is explicitly excluded from collision-asset generation.

strict_test: All C09 and C10 worlds; no benchmark/M-TARE world is readable by this operation.

sampling.rule: Preserve exact world, traversal, route order, arc and frame index. Geometry reads only graph/splines/radius/FTA. Outside a predeclared explicit-node local arc/3-D neighbourhood XY is unchanged; inside it a deterministic constrained XY/z solution is permitted. Three fixed voxel sizes 0.10/0.05/0.025m are all audited; parameter candidates are not independent samples.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher and no native perception-mesh hit may determine collision geometry. The generated collision/support mesh supplies horizontal/up/down qualification only.
teacher.valid_mask: Every frame at each resolution must have horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m, up>=0.8m and pass frozen continuity limits. Resolution pass/fail identities must agree exactly.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: This qualification creates no LiDAR or model output and runs no planner; a pass only restores eligibility to request a separate causal replay.

split.historical_pollution_audit: Only the three C08 development inputs and their source provenance are readable. C09/C10, M-TARE, checkpoints, validation/test statistics and model outputs remain excluded.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU voxel-SDF/marching-cubes and Open3D rays; zero GPU. Cost is a bound pending prototype benchmark, not an execution authorization.

evidence.machine_metrics: Per-resolution SDF/mesh provenance, non-incident separation, mesh-integrity/convergence reports, three corrected trajectory NPZs, 4773-row-per-resolution clearance audits and continuity metrics.
evidence.complete_visual_review: One complete XY/XZ collision-and-route figure plus clearance/continuity figure for each world and resolution.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source drift, non-incident overlap, open/non-manifold local surface, resolution disagreement, failed frame or forbidden read is a FAIL; no parameter change, resolution selection, deletion or retry.
